Notes: Aggregated upward from contained settlements. region_settle converts safety into hex.population (wilderness→populace). region_shelter gates on safety (non-depleting) to restore NPC vitality.
region_irrigate converts geologic_stability into hex.food. Only named inflow is artifact purification (high Res·Y); otherwise drifts down via engine_decay.

Named Outflows (signature; form): faction_consecrate (target; shifts Res·X UP → Resonant; plane-plane mutual with Faction.Ideo·X); artifact_emanate (target; shifts Res·X UP → Resonant; polar→plane, depletes artifact.containment)
Rate Modulators (flow -> direction; form: region_attune (self; shifts Res·X DOWN → Quiescent; plane-plane, also shifts NPC.Ideo·X UP → Individualist)
column13: Plane rows: 'Inflow'/'Outflow' = axis shift UP/DOWN. Res·X shifts UP via consecrate and emanate (toward Resonant). Res·X shifts DOWN via attune (toward Quiescent) — attuning an NPC spends the land's resonance. Res·Y reserved extension space.
